description: A nine-year-old translating a benefits appeal, an eviction notice or an oncology consultation. They acquire the language faster, so they acquire the responsibility, and with it the content.
energy_note: Told your mother's prognosis before she is.

description: Once a child has managed the household's business, the parent is not restored to authority afterwards. The relationship is reorganised for life.
energy_note: You cannot be their child again after that.

aspect: It produces competence and no capacity for rest
description: These children are frequently high-achieving, reliable adults who cannot delegate, cannot be cared for and cannot stop. It presents at forty as burnout with no obvious cause.
energy_note: Extremely capable, and unable to sit down.

description: She is eleven. The consultant uses the word 'palliative'. She knows what it means because she looked it up on the bus, and now she has to turn to her mother and choose a word in Farsi.
energy_note: Choosing the word that will tell your mother.
